title: Meeting recordings: Refreshed loading states
description:
Loom is introducing updated loading states for the meeting recordings app to provide a more consistent and modern experience. These refreshed visuals, including new skeleton screens and illustrations, ensure a seamless transition between the web and desktop apps while you wait for your content to load. Open the Loom desktop app or sign in to Loom on the web.
	Navigate to any recording that includes the Agent, Notes, and Transcript tabs.
